2_sparse_history.hierarchical_fallback_policy: Tested and recorded only. Official probabilities not modified. Requires out-of-sample validation before any production fallback.

catalog.large_model_disagreement: Player TD v1 and M6 HistGBM differ by more than 10 percentage points.
catalog.extreme_model_disagreement: Model gap exceeds 20 percentage points — inspect both estimates before trusting either.
catalog.limited_player_history: Fewer than 5 prior games in the research sample.
catalog.no_prior_games: No prior box-score games for this player in the research frame.
catalog.unknown_availability: Injury/availability status is unknown — not assumed healthy.
catalog.availability_risk: Player is doubtful or out on the latest injury designation.
catalog.missing_or_defaulted_defense: Opponent defensive feature missing or defaulted to league average.
catalog.missing_current_season_td_signal: No prior or roll3 TD rate available.
catalog.stale_sportsbook_price: Latest sportsbook tick is older than the research freshness window.
catalog.sparse_history_extrapolation: Extreme probability may reflect extrapolation from thin history.
catalog.hierarchical_fallback_suggested: Research-only: hierarchical prior is far from the model estimate (not applied).
catalog.m5_artifact_rate_vs_current_form: M5 primary probability remains high/low relative to current-season TD rate — artifact player rates may outweigh live form until M5 is explicitly retrained.
catalog.research_only_not_a_bet: Research forecast only. Not a validated betting recommendation. Play disabled.
catalog.involved_conditional_not_game_level: Locked C_recent is involved-conditional and has no current-role participation term. Raw score is retained for inspection only — not ranked as a game-level projection.

3_warnings_added.note: Warnings are research triage labels, not statistical confidence intervals.

freeze.shadow_connection: use ingest_freeze_into_shadow to write append-only ShadowPrediction rows
